title: Euphorbia factor L2 alleviated gouty inflammation by specifically suppressing both the priming and activation of NLRP3 inflammasome.
authors: Li, Yanhong; Zhuang, Yuqing; Chen, Yuehong; Wang, Guan; Tang, Zhigang; Zhong, Yutong; Zhang, Yuanyuan; Wu, Liang; Ji, Xing; Zhang, Qiuping; Pan, Bin; Luo, Yubin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物EFL2通过结合糖皮质激素受体抑制NLRP3炎症小体缓解痛风炎症，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Euphorbia L. is a traditionally used herb and contains many newly identified compounds with novel chemical structures. Euphorbia factor L2 (EFL2), a diterpenoid derived from Euphorbia seeds, is reported to alleviate acute lung injury and arthritis by exerting anti-inflammatory effects. In this study, we aimed to test the therapeutic benefit and mechanisms of EFL2 in NLRP3 inflammasome-mediated gouty models and identified the potential molecular mechanism. A cell-based system was used to test the specific inhibitory effect of EFL2 on NLRP3-related inflammation. The gouty arthritis model and an air pouch inflammation model induced by monosodium urate monohydrate (MSU) crystals were used for in vivo experiments. Nlrp3(-/-) mice and in vitro studies were used for mechanistic exploration. Virtual molecular docking and biophysical assays were performed to identify the direct binding and regulatory target of EFL2. The inhibitory effect of EFL2 on inflammatory cell infiltration was determined by flow cytometry in vivo. The mechanism by which EFL2 activates the NLRP3 inflammasome signaling pathway was evaluated by immunological experiment and transmission electron microscopy. In vitro, EFL2 specifically reduced NLRP3 inflammasome-mediated IL-1beta production and alleviated MSU crystal-induced arthritis, as well as inflammatory cell infiltration. EFL2 downregulated NF-kappaB phosphorylation and NLRP3 inflammasome expression by binding to glucocorticoid receptors. Moreover, EFL2 could specifically suppress the lysosome damage-mediated NLRP3 inflammasome activation process. It is expected that this work may be useful to accelerate the development of anti-inflammatory drugs originated from traditional herbs and improve therapeutics in gout and its complications.
abstract_zh: 大戟（Euphorbia L.）是一种传统草药，含有许多新发现的具有新颖化学结构的化合物。大戟因子L2（EFL2），一种源自大戟种子的二萜类化合物，据报道通过发挥抗炎作用可缓解急性肺损伤和关节炎。在本研究中，我们旨在测试EFL2在NLRP3炎症小体介导的痛风模型中的治疗效益及其机制，并确定潜在的分子机制。我们使用基于细胞的系统来测试EFL2对NLRP3相关炎症的特异性抑制作用。采用单钠尿酸盐（MSU）晶体诱导的痛风性关节炎模型和气囊炎症模型进行体内实验。利用Nlrp3(-/-)小鼠和体外研究进行机制探索。通过虚拟分子对接和生物物理测定来识别EFL2的直接结合和调控靶点。通过流式细胞术在体内测定EFL2对炎症细胞浸润的抑制作用。通过免疫学实验和透射电子显微镜评估EFL2激活NLRP3炎症小体信号通路的机制。在体外，EFL2特异性减少NLRP3炎症小体介导的IL-1β产生，并缓解MSU晶体诱导的关节炎及炎症细胞浸润。EFL2通过结合糖皮质激素受体下调NF-κB磷酸化和NLRP3炎症小体表达。此外，EFL2能特异性抑制溶酶体损伤介导的NLRP3炎症小体激活过程。预期这项工作可能有助于加速源自传统草药的抗炎药物的开发，并改善痛风及其并发症的治疗。
